doc:
# Basic — Superconductors

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic superconductor”).

claims.name: standard_holographic_superconductor_setup_extends
claims.statement: The standard holographic superconductor setup extends to a rotating 2D holographic superconductor in the probe limit and small angular momentum approximation.

sources.title: Analytical approach to phase transitions in rotating and non-rotating 2D holographic superconductors

claims.name: phase_transitions_between_swave_holographic
claims.statement: Phase transitions between s-wave holographic insulator/superconductor and metal/superconductor are studied analytically.

sources.title: Analytic investigation of holographic phase transitions influenced by dark matter sector

claims.name: superconductor_effect_momentum_relaxation_combined
claims.statement: The superconductor effect and momentum relaxation are combined in the holographic relaxed superconductor system.

sources.title: Entanglement of Purification for Momentum Relaxed Superconductor

claims.name: holographic_superconductor_model_behaves_type
claims.statement: The holographic superconductor model behaves as a type II superconductor under the effect of magnetic fields.

claims.name: holographic_einsteinmaxwelldilatonaxion_emda_pwave_superconductor
claims.statement: A holographic Einstein--Maxwell--Dilaton--Axion (EMDA) p-wave superconductor exhibits a superconductor--insulator transition (SIT).

sources.title: Quantum criticality and mixed-state entanglement in holographic superconductor--insulator transitions

claims.name: holographic_superconductor_model_has_kink
claims.statement: The holographic superconductor model has kink crystalline condensates.

sources.title: Kink Crystalline Condensate and Multi-kink Solution in Holographic Superconductor

claims.name: minimal_holographic_superconductor_finite_coupling
claims.statement: For a minimal holographic superconductor at finite coupling, the dual Ginzburg-Landau theory can be identified exactly in the Gauss-Bonnet holographic superconductor, including exact numerical coefficients.

sources.title: The dual Ginzburg-Landau theory for a holographic superconductor: Finite coupling corrections

claims.name: st_ckelberg_holographic_superconductor_constructed
claims.statement: The Stückelberg holographic superconductor is constructed with Weyl corrections.

sources.title: The Stückelberg Holographic Superconductors with Weyl corrections

claims.name: standard_holographic_superconductor_described_notes
claims.statement: The standard holographic superconductor is described in the notes.

claims.name: preferred_ground_state_holographic_superconductor
claims.statement: The preferred ground state can be a holographic superconductor.

claims.name: condensation_operator_holographic_superconductor_computed
claims.statement: The condensation operator of the holographic superconductor is computed.

sources.title: Noncommutative effects of charged black hole on holographic superconductors

claims.name: momentum_relaxation_affects_information_quantities
claims.statement: Momentum relaxation affects information quantities in holographic superconductor systems.

sources.title: Entanglement of Purification for Momentum Relaxed Superconductor

claims.name: holographic_superconductor_model_has_metastable
claims.statement: The holographic superconductor model has metastable multi-kink solutions.

sources.title: Kink Crystalline Condensate and Multi-kink Solution in Holographic Superconductor

claims.name: photon_coupled_holographic_superconductor_acquires
claims.statement: A photon coupled to the holographic superconductor acquires a mass.

claims.name: below_critical_temperature_holographic_superconductor
claims.statement: Below a critical temperature, holographic superconductor solutions are thermodynamically preferred.

sources.title: Minimal Holographic Superconductors from Maximal Supergravity

claims.name: holographic_superconductor_constructed_massive_gravity
claims.statement: A holographic superconductor is constructed in a massive gravity background.

sources.title: Holographic superconductors from the massive gravity

claims.name: model_realizes_pwave_holographic_insulator
claims.statement: The model realizes a p-wave holographic insulator/superconductor transition.

claims.name: nonabelian_holographic_superconductor_admits_only
claims.statement: The non-Abelian holographic superconductor admits only a droplet solution.

sources.title: d-wave Holographic Superconductor Vortex Lattice and Non-Abelian Holographic Superconductor Droplet
